title: Document reflects the resource back with an uppercase host
rationale: Scheme and host are case-insensitive, so this is the same identifier rather than a near-miss, and it does not belong in the R9.5 sensitivity pair either. The companion fixture `c12-violating-case-in-path` shows why the whole URI must not be lowercased to achieve this.

spec.quote: the scheme and host are case-insensitive and therefore should be normalized to lowercase ... The other generic syntax components are assumed to be case-sensitive unless specifically defined otherwise by the scheme.

documents.comment: everything but the `resource` value is conforming
conforming, so only C12 is under test
